description: Public procurement contracts from SEAP, Romania's electronic procurement system: what a company won from public authorities, or what it awarded as a contracting authority. Each contract carries the contracting authority, CPV code, contract number, date and value in RON, plus a per-year summary and the top counterparties. Source: ANAP reports published by ADR on data.gov.ro (CC-BY 4.0), loaded quarterly.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

role.description: 'supplier' = contracts the company won; 'authority' = contracts it awarded; 'both'.
role.title: Role

since.description: Only contracts dated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
since.title: Since

until.description: Only contracts dated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
until.title: Until

name: company_contracts

outputSchema.description: Public procurement contracts from SEAP: won by the firm, or awarded by it.

asOf.description: The publisher's date for the newest workbook loaded (quarterly).

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

contracts.description: contractNo, contractDate, valueRon, cpv, cpvName, lot, authority{name,cui}, winner{name,cui}, newest first.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

found.description: Whether any contract is on record.

lots.description: Lot rows on record, which is more than total when a framework contract has lots.

role.description: What was queried: supplier, authority or both.

sharedContracts.description: Contracts on which other winners are also named (their whole value is in sharedValueRon, not counted as this firm's own).

sharedValueRon.description: Sum of the shared awards' whole values (RON).

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

top.description: Top 10 counterparties: the authorities a supplier won from, or the winners an authority awarded to (name, cui, contracts, valueRon).

total.description: Distinct contracts on record (a framework contract repeats its value on every lot row, so it counts once).

totalValueRon.description: Sum of the values of contracts this firm won alone (RON). A framework's whole value is not attributed to each of its winners: those are counted in sharedValueRon.

years.description: Per year: contracts and valueRon, newest first.

title: Public contracts won or awarded
